Life.Name: Inshurense Ya Vupfhumba
Life.Description: Hi nyikela swipimelo swa kahle ku sirhelekisa wena na ndyangu wa wena eka switlhavi, nhloko ya rifu, na swilo leswi nga ha humelelaka, ku tiyisa ku rhula ka nkoka wa timali.

Life.Name: Inshurense Ya Vupfhumba
Life.Description: Hi nyika swipimelo ku sirhelekisa vutomi na vutomi bya vatirhi, ku tiyisa ku pfuna eka switlhavi, mintsongo na swilo leswi nga ha humelelaka, ku endla leswaku ntirho wu tshama wu ri karhi wu sirhelekile.

NonLife.Name: Inshurense Ya Ku Lahleka Ka Switirhisiwa
NonLife.Description: Hi nyika swipimelo swo tala ku sirhelekisa swilo swa vatirhi, ku katsa tiendlelo, ximobilho na mimbuyelo ya ntirho, ku sirhelekisa switirhisiwa swa vhumbirhi eka swirhavi swa siku na siku.

NonLife.Feature6: Mimbuyelo Ya Ntirho – Hinkwaswo, Ku tirha, Vaxavisi, Switirhisiwa Na Ntirho

AboutUs.Description: Hi sisitiwa ku tirhela ku nyika vatirhi swipimelo swa inshurense hi ndlela yo endla leswaku tikhwatsi ta vona ti sirhelekile hi ku kongoma eka swirhavi leswi nga ha humelelaka.

WhyChooseUs.Subtitle: Hikuva Hlawula Hina

Feature1.Title: Ku landzelela ka nkarhi hinkwawo
Feature1.Description: Hi tshama na mutirhi evuton’wini hinkwabyo, hi ri karhi hi nyika mpfuno eka switlhavi na mhaka yin’wana ya inshurense.

Feature2.Title: Ku Sirhelekisa Switirho
Feature2.Description: Hi tirhela ku sirhelekisa tikhwatsi, timali na switirhisiwa swa mutirhi, hi tirhisa ndlela yo sungula ku khathalela khuselo na ku rhula.

Feature3.Title: Rungula Ra Vuhlayiseki A Hi Rhi Ema Tixavisa
Feature3.Description: Hi nyika mpfuno wo kota ku pfuna hi mahala, hi endla leswaku vutihlamuleri bya wena byi tswala swinene.

WhyChooseUs.ImageAlt: Ku hlangana na mutirhi wa inshurense

Consultant.title: Mpfuneto Wa Mahala!
Consultant.description: U hakela ntsena hi ku hakela nhlayo ya inshurense. Tinxaka ta hina ta vukorhokeri ti tshama ti le handle ka wena, ti ri karhi ti pfuna eka nkarhi wa wena wa inshurense, naswona
Consultant.Not: a hi endli nhlayo yo engetela!

1.content: Ku tiyisisa ku rhula ka tikhwatsi na ndyangu wa mina ku nga yin’wana ya swiboho swa kahle swinene leswi ndzi swi endleke.
1.name: João Silva

2.content: Hi nkarhi wa timinete ta 15 ndzi kumile ndhavuko lowu a wuriwa hi van’wana masiku ku wu nyika. Swi tsakisa swinene!
2.name: Maria Santos

3.content: Mpfuno wa munhu wu endla ku hambana. Va hlamusele swikombiso hinkwaswo hi ku tiyisisa na ku twisisa.
3.name: Carlos Costa
